milestones.title: Core API supports extension state storage and indicators; extension works end-to-end
milestones.goal: ExtensionApi has getExtensionState/setExtensionState and registerExtensionIndicator. Spec-mode extension in ~/.mu/agent/extensions/spec-mode/ registers commands, persists state, shows visual feedback, and injects prompt reminders.

verification.command: As a verifier agent, review the implementation: (1) Run git diff to see changed files in packages/coding-agent/src/extensions/, (2) Read types.ts and verify ExtensionApi has getExtensionState/setExtensionState signatures, (3) Verify ExtensionApi has registerExtensionIndicator/updateExtensionIndicator/removeExtensionIndicator signatures, (4) Read manager.ts and verify state storage implementation persists to JSON files in ~/.mu/agent/extensions/<name>/state.json, (5) Verify indicator registry implementation, (6) Read footer.ts and verify FooterComponent renders indicators from ExtensionManager, (7) Compare against SPEC.md, (8) Write findings to evidence file.
verification.expect: Review finds correct implementation of state storage and indicator APIs with real integration points, or reports blocking findings with file/line references.

verification.command: As a verifier agent, review the extension: (1) Verify ~/.mu/agent/extensions/spec-mode/ exists with index.ts, reminders.ts, verifier.ts, (2) Read index.ts and verify it uses registerCommand (not a new primitive), getExtensionState/setExtensionState for persistence, context hook for prompt injection, (3) Verify /spec, /discover, /normal commands are registered, (4) Verify commands print confirmation messages via api.print(), (5) Verify context hook appends reminders from reminders.ts, (6) Compare against SPEC.md, (7) Write findings to evidence file.
verification.expect: Review confirms extension correctly uses existing primitives and implements all required functionality, or reports blocking findings with file/line references.

verification.command: Run mu with spec-mode extension, type '/', verify /spec, /discover, /normal appear, select /spec, verify confirmation message 'Spec mode active' appears
verification.expect: Slash commands work and confirmation messages are visible.

verification.command: Capture system prompt sent to LLM in each mode, assert suffix presence/absence and content
verification.expect: Spec mode appends spec reminder, discover appends problem discovery reminder, normal has no suffix.

verification.command: Set mode to spec, trigger extension reload, verify mode is restored from state storage
verification.expect: Extension state persists across reloads via ~/.mu/agent/extensions/spec-mode/state.json.

verification.command: Load spec-mode extension plus another extension with indicator, verify both indicators render without conflict
verification.expect: Multiple extension indicators can coexist in footer.

milestones.notes: First milestone closes when core APIs work, extension is implemented, and edge cases (reload, multiple extensions) are verified.

milestones.title: Verifier agent validates spec output with validation contracts
milestones.goal: Extension can spawn verifier child agent to review assistant responses against validation contracts and report PASS/FAIL with findings.

verification.command: As a verifier agent, review the implementation: (1) Read ~/.mu/agent/extensions/spec-mode/verifier.ts, (2) Verify it can spawn child agent with spawn_agent, (3) Verify validation contract is passed to child context, (4) Verify PASS/FAIL response format with findings array, (5) Verify integration point shows verifier output to human before approval, (6) Verify verifier failure handling (degrades gracefully), (7) Write findings to evidence file.
verification.expect: Review confirms verifier correctly validates spec output and handles failures gracefully, or reports blocking findings.

verification.command: Run mu in spec mode, ask for a spec, observe verifier output in transcript before human approval
verification.expect: Human sees verifier PASS/FAIL with findings before deciding to proceed.

verification.command: Simulate verifier spawn failure, verify session continues without wedging
verification.expect: Verifier failure degrades visibly without blocking the session.

milestones.notes: Second milestone closes when verifier agent correctly validates spec output, integrates into approval flow, and handles failures gracefully.
